rationale: The original short thesis relied on a rejection at $98.72 and renewed selling pressure toward the $98.34 5-minute 9-EMA, which has failed as price held above $98.37 and broke above $98.72 on expanding 1-minute volume (38.8k shares). With price now reclaiming the 5-minute 9-EMA and pushing up to $98.83, short-term momentum has shifted upward, warranting an exit ahead of the $99.05 hard invalidation. However, because ABT remains heavily offered on the day well below session VWAP ($100.38) on 4.45x relative volume, flipping to long is not justified.
